newsitem.title: USA: Three children die in S. California trailer fire.
newsitem.headline: Three children die in S. California trailer fire.

text.p: Three children died Sunday in a fire that destroyed a mobile home, San Bernardino fire officials said.
A spokeswoman said a girl, 12, and two boys, 10 and 8, were killed in the fire that officials believe was caused by a kerosene lantern.
The children's mother escaped the blaze in the town of Muscoy, just outside San Barnardino, which is 50 miles (80 km) east of Los Angeles.
Officials were investigating the blaze, the spokeswoman said.
